Klasse Headers

java.lang.Object
dev.toonformat.jtoon.util.Headers
public final class Headers extends Object

  • Felddetails

    • ARRAY_HEADER_PATTERN

      public static final Pattern ARRAY_HEADER_PATTERN
      Matches standalone array headers: [3], [3\t], [2|]. Group 1: optional # marker, captured so strict mode can reject it (§6), Group 2: digits, Group 3: optional delimiter

    • TABULAR_HEADER_PATTERN

      public static final Pattern TABULAR_HEADER_PATTERN
      Matches tabular array headers with field names: [2]{id,name,role}:. Group 1: optional # marker, captured so strict mode can reject it (§6), Group 2: digits, Group 3: optional delimiter, Group 4: field spec

    • KEYED_ARRAY_PATTERN

      public static final Pattern KEYED_ARRAY_PATTERN
      The keyed header scanner matchKeyedArrayHeader(String) replaces the regex-based dispatch: a field spec may nest braces at any depth ({geo{point{lat,lon}}}, §6, §9.3), which a flat regex cannot express. The former KEYED_ARRAY_PATTERN is kept only for its key and bracket-segment grammar, documented below. Its [^\[\]:\s]++ key alternative is the encoder form of §7.3 and is narrower than what scanUnquotedKey(String, int, int) accepts: §7.4 requires decoders to accept any unquoted key token, so this pattern is documentation, not the accepted language. Matches keyed array headers: items[2]{id,name}: or tags[3]:. Group 1: key, Group 2: delimiter, Group 3: flat field spec.

  • Methodendetails

    • matchKeyedArrayHeader

      public static @Nullable Headers.KeyedHeaderMatch matchKeyedArrayHeader(String content)
      Scans a line for a keyed header (key[N<delim?>]{field…}: …) per the §6 grammar, accepting field specs with braces nested at any depth. Braces, delimiters and colons inside quoted field names do not count as structure. The bracket segment may declare a keyed marker ([N:] or [N:delim], §9.5).
      Parameter:
      content - the line content to scan
      Gibt zurück:
      the keyed header match, or null when the content is not a keyed header

    • matchKeylessKeyedHeader

      public static @Nullable Headers.KeyedHeaderMatch matchKeylessKeyedHeader(String content)
      Scans a keyless header that starts with a bracket segment, for root-form discovery (§5). The match is returned whether or not it declares a keyed marker; callers must test keyed() to tell [2:]{…}: (keyed tabular object, §9.5) from [2]{…}: (plain keyless tabular array).
      Parameter:
      content - the line content to scan
      Gibt zurück:
      the keyless header match, or null when the content is not a keyless header
